card.name: "Including" before listed severe reactions
card.fires_on: The word "including" or "included" right after a named reaction or drug class, where a list of specific severe reactions follows, mostly in warning headings.

modes.label: Warning heading
modes.description: "INCLUDING" in a capitalized boxed-warning title before a named reaction such as anaphylaxis.
modes.example: WARNING: HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS<< INCLUDING>> ANAPHYLAXIS Patients treated with

modes.label: Reactions to a drug class
modes.description: "including" after sulfonamides introduces named severe skin reactions.
modes.example: Fatalities have occurred, although rarely, due to severe reactions to sulfonamides<< including>> Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic ep

modes.label: Reports of reactions
modes.description: "included" in a sentence reporting which hypersensitivity reactions occurred.
modes.example: hypersensitivity reactions have<< included>> anaphylactic reaction and angio

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly programming type words and look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the word "including" that opens a list of specific serious reactions in a warning.
